_note: Post hoc author judgments (PROTOCOL.md endpoints E-A, E-B and Amendment 1.4), written 2026-09-06 from the published quotes and objections in RESULTS.md before the checker verdicts were read. target_match = the objection targets the documented defect named in cases.json (the step or lemma, not merely the same obligation). A text counts as recovered by a procedure only if target_match is true AND the analysis classifies that procedure's best objection on the text as substantiated or localized. distinct_defect labels are shared between texts carrying the same defect. conclusion_change records which side of the earlier evaluator disagreement the objections support and which lineage conclusion changes if the defect is applied with the validity_overrides.json criterion.
